settles.entry: mohaa, q3-ihv, q3test: the pure gamestate budget still measures Quake Live; Medal of Honor needs a measure of its own baselines

outcome.mohaa: measured on its own wire and limit with its own baselines, and measured again after its multiplayer game registers its sounds
outcome.q3-ihv: no budget applies: no pure mode in the engine and no pak list in the clients' systeminfo; sv_pure publishes nothing and warns
outcome.q3test: no budget applies: no pure mode in any release and no pak list in the clients' systeminfo; sv_pure publishes nothing and warns

platform: Windows 11 Home 10.0.26200; static reads with pefile; Windows x86 MSVC build (meson debugoptimized, strict warnings); clang i686-pc-windows-msvc fixtures

publishedRetailLog.version: Medal of Honor Allied Assault 1.11 linux-i386 Jul 23 2002
publishedRetailLog.note: published observation, not a probe of ours; nothing is printed between the two lines

inferences: fnTech3's pure gamestate budget is an engine policy (from Quake3e), not a retail contract; it must measure the gamestate clients are sent to keep a server from an overflow.
With no pure mode in their engines and no pak list in their clients' systeminfo, no budget applies to the IHV Test or Q3Test.
Medal of Honor 1.00's engine registers a multiplayer game's sounds after publishing sv_paks, as OpenMoHAA does; its executable cannot be read.
Under HEAD's Quake Live measure a Medal of Honor map with two or three times the stock maps' configstrings before its sounds would have fallen to degraded pure although its 48 KiB message had room.

changes.code/server/sv_client.cpp: SV_RemainingGameState measures Medal of Honor on its own wire and limit, with its baselines written by SV_MOHAAWriteBaselines
changes.code/server/sv_init.cpp: the pure-pak step becomes SV_SetPurePaks; it publishes nothing for the IHV Test and Q3Test and warns when sv_pure is set; after SV_MOHAASpawnDone it runs again and the systeminfo is republished
changes.tests/gamestate_budget_wire_tests.py: Medal of Honor estimates, the sounds spawn, the no-pure profiles, and five mutations
changes.tests/rtcw_gamestate_budget_tests.py: pins the new own-wire profile list

mohaaProbe.what: an instrumented export of HEAD aa0e7049 with this change (tools/instrument.py, never committed): HEAD's SV_RemainingGameState beside the new one at each measure, and at the end of the spawn the gamestate SV_SendClientGameState's own text writes for client 0
mohaaProbe.command: fntech3.ded.exe +set com_gameProfile mohaa +set fs_basepath "E:\Games\Medal of Honor Allied Assault" +set fs_homepath <isolated home> +set logfile 2 +set developer 1 +set dedicated 1 +set net_enabled 0 +set sv_pure 1 +set g_gametype <1 dm, 4 obj> +set com_steamIntegration 0 +set fs_skipWorkshop 1 +set sv_errorExit 0 +exec purebudget.cfg (map <name>)
mohaaProbe.outcome: sv_paks published on all eleven maps before and after this change

tests/gamestate_budget_wire_tests.py.probe: production estimate, gamestate writer, Medal of Honor baseline writer, SV_SetPurePaks and the end of Medal of Honor's spawn, with the engine and Medal of Honor codecs
